items.title: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
items.excerpt: Threat actors are deploying GSocket on compromised Linux servers to keep encrypted remote access after the original vulnerability is patched. Learn how to detect, investigate, and remediate this activity. The post The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2 appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .

items.title: Ransomware recovery is now a client retention metric
items.excerpt: Recovering from ransomware doesn't guarantee an MSP will retain its clients, especially when delays, poor communication, and unexpected costs undermine trust. Kaseya examines how disconnected recovery tools create these problems and how integrated workflows can improve response times, transparency, and client retention. [...]

items.title: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution
items.excerpt: Four flaws that attackers could exploit without logging in were fixed today as part of SAP's monthly Security Patch Day—the vendor rates all four 10.0, the maximum CVSS score.
